action.details: Opens UpNote's documented x-callback URL with the selection encoded as Markdown text. ActionClip does not add a title, notebook, or browser source URL.
action.exampleOutput: UpNote creates a new note containing the Markdown text.
action.name: UpNote
action.privacySummary: ActionClip passes the selected text locally to UpNote through its app URL. UpNote controls any later sync.
action.requirements: UpNote must be installed and its x-callback URL support must be enabled.
action.summary: Create a new UpNote note from the selected text.
